decisions.reason: Close to the established cardboard display core, keeping costs are low and residual demand uncertainty still justifies holding this option.
The pegboard variant remains an inexpensive incremental option, but its niche market signal has not yet clearly resolved.
It overlaps heavily with other quarter-pallet displays, so the option's incremental value is limited and resources are better redeployed.
The wooden pallet is a larger departure from the core cardboard offer with higher keeping costs and no strong market confirmation, so the option should be abandoned.
